property_summary: Once C is initialized via Initialized(), no call to SetMinSum may ever change MinSum again — the correct contract leaves MinSum equal to the value last set before initialization (a post-initialization SetMinSum is a no-op revert), while the mutant lets SetMinSum overwrite MinSum to any new value.
change_summary: Delete the guard statement `if(intitalized)revert();` so SetMinSum can update MinSum even after initialization.
